name: Celery

low.description: Very small serving (less than 5cm of stalk)

high.description: Standard serving is high in mannitol

siboNotes: Celery has a very low safe serving size - only about 5cm of stalk (15g). It's particularly high in mannitol. Most people need to avoid or severely limit celery during SIBO treatment. Use cucumber as an alternative for crunch.
preparationTips: If using, limit to a few small pieces for flavor
Often hidden in soups and stocks - check ingredients
Cucumber provides similar crunch with no FODMAPs
